title: Fantasy Warrior Woman Quad
description: Four nearly identical panels depict a fierce female warrior with a high ponytail standing atop a rocky outcrop. She wears a red and black corset-style outfit with green accents, holds a glowing sword aloft in one hand and a large blade in the other, with purple magical energy swirling around her and red flames at her feet.
prompt: A powerful female warrior with long dark hair in a high ponytail stands dynamically on a pile of dark rocks with glowing green crystals and red flames at her boots. She wears a red and black corset with green details, armored gauntlets, and thigh-high boots. In one hand she raises a sword emitting purple magical smoke, in the other she holds a large blade. Her pose is confident and battle-ready, with dramatic purple energy swirls around her against a smoky abstract background with floating colorful orbs, in a detailed comic book illustration style shown in four nearly identical panels side by side
